resources.string: Current UV index, coloured by strength
No location set for the UV widget
The widget shows the UV index for this location. It is blue while the sun is below the horizon, then green through to red as the UV index rises.
Or enter a location by hand, used when the device location is unavailable:
Could not get a location fix. Enter one by hand below.
No location yet — allow location access or enter one by hand.
Location access denied. Enter a location by hand instead.
Android only allows this app to read your location while this screen is open, so the widget reuses the last location captured here. Open this screen again after travelling.
